[RS_SOMEIP_00029] SOME/IP protocol shall specify how data in the payload are
aligned ⌈
Description:
SOME/IP protocol shall specify how data in the payload are aligned. This
includes the start of primitive data types and gaps between them.
Rationale:
Some architectures allow a faster access to data which are aligned in memory.
If speed matters, it is useful to be able to influence the alignment and optimize
the accesses.
Use Case:
Fast access to serialized representation of structured data types.
AppliesTo:
FO
De
